entries.title: Careful pull requests carry their pipeline record
entries.body: A Careful task's pull request on GitHub now ends with a Pipeline section saying its review, testing and documents check passed at that exact version. A repository that requires that record before merging accepts the pull request. When a later push moves the pull request on, the record follows only after Careful's review of the update passes.
entries.noPicture: The record shows in the pull request's description on GitHub, not on a screen of the app.
